operative_text: SECTION 2 (new, HRS ch. 134): §134- Negligent concealment of a firearm by a licensee. (a) A person commits the offense of negligent concealment of a firearm by a licensee if the person holds a valid concealed carry firearms license and: (1) Without legal justification, displays or fails to completely conceal the licensed firearm, even briefly, causing alarm to any other person; or (2) Fails to secure the firearm on their person by dropping it in open view of any other person or by leaving the firearm in a public place. (b) Negligent concealment of a firearm by a licensee is a petty misdemeanor.
